# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(broom); library(gtsummary); library(sandwich); library(lmtest); library(performance); library(pscl) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
dg_path <- c("data/dengue_wards.csv", "../data/dengue_wards.csv", "../../data/dengue_wards.csv")
dg_path <- dg_path[file.exists(dg_path)][1]
dg <- read_csv(dg_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(slum = factor(slum, 0:1, c("Non-slum", "Slum")), fogging = factor(fogging, 0:1, c("No", "Yes")))
dg$ward <- factor(dg$ward)
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code:
m0 <- glm(cases ~ fogging, family = poisson, data = dg)                                   # no offset: compares MEAN COUNTS
m1 <- glm(cases ~ fogging + offset(log(population)), family = poisson, data = dg)         # with offset: compares RATES
round(exp(cbind(no_offset = coef(m0), with_offset = coef(m1)))["foggingYes", ], 2)

m2 <- glm(cases ~ fogging + slum + rain_lag1 + month_index + sin(2 * pi * month / 12) + cos(2 * pi * month / 12) + offset(log(population)), family = poisson, data = dg)
tbl_regression(m2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = c(fogging, slum, rain_lag1, month_index))

nd <- tibble(fogging = factor("No", levels = levels(dg$fogging)), slum = factor("Slum", levels = levels(dg$slum)), rain_lag1 = 150, month_index = 20, month = 7, population = 30000)
predict(m2, newdata = nd, type = "response")
